summary_md:
**Oai Chu ([@oaichu95](https://x.com/oaichu95/status/2115660960728047630))** reports that MiniMax's coding team open-sourced **mcode-stack**, the 17 SKILL.md workflows they use daily — from `subagent-split-check` to `independent-review` — installable in Claude Code via its plugin marketplace.

The attached card groups them as plan & split, context & tools (tool-budget and context-tax audits), long sessions (handoff docs, long-command checks), review, and experiments/hotfixes (including `harness-experiment` and `trajectory-review`).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - MiniMax-AI/mcode-stack: The workflows and skills the MiniMax Code team uses to build MiniMax Code. Open source, install and use.

relevance: A production team's real skill set, including harness-experiment and context-cost audits — great raw material for agent rules.
